sanskrit_verse:
तवाहमिति चात्मानं योऽस्वतन्त्रः प्रयच्छति ।
न स तं प्राप्नुयात् कामं पूर्वस्वामी लभेत तम् ॥
transliteration: tavāham iti cātmānaṃ yo 'svatantraḥ prayacchati | na sa taṃ prāpnuyāt kāmaṃ pūrvasvāmī labheta tam ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who surrenders the Self as 'I am Yours', yet remains unliberated in consciousness, does not attain that desired fruit; the former owner retains claim.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from realized sovereignty of Self, not external designation
Causation arises through conscious capacity, not performative submission
Capacity-based responsibility requires self-governance prior to surrender
Restoration logic demands recognition of prior ownership until full release
Consciousness alignment supersedes ritualistic or verbal offerings
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent.self_governance_status = false THEN surrender_action.validity = null
IF prior_owner.conscious_claim_exists = true AND current_surrender.capacity_verified = false THEN ownership.reverts_to_prior
IF claimant.dharma_siddhi < threshold THEN executed_transfer.rights_withheld = true
supreme_court_application: In matters involving spiritual or existential rights transfers, the Supreme Court must verify the consciousness-capacity of the surrendering party before recognizing any transfer. Verbal declarations alone without demonstrable self-mastery shall not constitute valid conveyance.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that only a liberated Self may truly give itself. Until such realization, the act lacks causal completeness. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows prior conditioning still binds the actor. Therefore, no punitive consequence arises—only completion of necessary unfoldment remains.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate svādhyāya protocol for surrendering individual until self-authority verified
Reconnect prior_owner to residual energetic claims via dharmic reconciliation process
Assign dharma-adhikari oversight until both parties achieve clarity of transactional integrity
Deploy śuddhi vidhi to clear karmic entanglements caused by incomplete surrender
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: only the liberated may lawfully offer the Self. Until then, all partial surrenders remain incomplete, awaiting conscious restoration under Dharma's non-punitive order. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
